description: This file defines the ElasticSearchHooks class which manages Elasticsearch indexing and removal for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM beans by implementing logic hooks such as beanSaved and beanDeleted. It handles indexing logic, error handling, and module blacklisting considerations.

classes.name: ElasticSearchHooks
classes.description: Handles logic hooks for synchronizing SugarCRM/SuiteCRM beans with Elasticsearch index, including save and delete events, blacklisting, and error handling.

methods.name: beanSaved
methods.description: Callback for when a bean is saved; triggers re-indexing if indexer is enabled.

methods.name: beanDeleted
methods.description: Callback for when a bean is deleted; triggers removal from index if indexer is enabled.

methods.name: reIndexSafe
methods.description: Executes reIndex and handles exceptions gracefully.

methods.name: reIndex
methods.description: Performs the re-indexing or removal of a bean based on its deleted status; throws exception if indexer is disabled.

methods.name: getIndexer
methods.description: Initializes the indexer object, either from the bean or by instantiating a new one.

methods.name: isBlacklisted
methods.description: Checks if the bean's module is blacklisted from indexing.

methods.name: correctAction
methods.description: Adjusts the action to 'remove' if the bean's deleted flag is set.

methods.name: performAction
methods.description: Performs the index or remove action on the bean based on the current action.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Logs errors occurring during re-indexing or removal operations.
